questions.stem: Which of the following diseases is caused by bacteria?
questions.solution: Typhoid is caused by bacteria. Asthma is a respiratory condition, Diabetes is a metabolic disorder, and Measles is a viral infection. Hence, the correct answer is Typhoid.

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a communicable disease?
questions.solution: Diabetes is not a communicable disease as it is a non-communicable disease caused by lifestyle factors. Chickenpox, tuberculosis, and dengue are all caused by pathogens and can spread from person to person.

questions.stem: What precautions should be taken before, during, and after a trip to a malaria-prone area?
questions.solution: Using mosquito repellent is a key precaution to avoid malaria. Eating junk food, wearing open shoes, and avoiding all water are not effective or practical. Hence, the correct answer is to use mosquito repellent.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best way to prevent the spread of diseases through contaminated food?
choices: Maintaining personal hygiene and good sanitary habits
Wearing a mask in crowded places
questions.solution: Maintaining personal hygiene and good sanitary habits is the best way to prevent the spread of diseases through contaminated food. This includes washing hands, cooking food properly, and drinking boiled water. Washing hands and wearing a mask are good practices but not specific to food contamination.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a method of preventing communicable diseases?
questions.solution: Washing hands frequently is a method to prevent communicable diseases by reducing the spread of pathogens. Eating more processed food, getting less exercise, and living longer lives are factors that may contribute to non-communicable diseases.

questions.stem: A doctor prescribes an antibiotic to a patient with a sore throat and fever. What is the most likely reason for this prescription?
choices: To prevent the spread of disease to others
questions.solution: Antibiotics are designed to kill or inhibit bacteria, so they are used to treat bacterial infections. Viral infections cannot be treated with antibiotics, and while reducing fever may be a side effect, it is not the primary purpose of the medication. Preventing the spread of disease is not the main reason for prescribing antibiotics.

questions.stem: Which of the following preventive measures is most effective in stopping the spread of tuberculosis?
choices: Wearing a mask in crowded places
Avoiding close contact with infected people
questions.solution: Vaccination is the most effective preventive measure for tuberculosis as it provides immunity against the disease. While other measures help, vaccination directly prevents the disease from occurring.

questions.stem: Which of the following diseases is caused by a worm?
